newsitem.title: ROMANIA: LACK OF FUNDS HIT ROMANIA 1997 WHEAT CROP-MP.
newsitem.headline: LACK OF FUNDS HIT ROMANIA 1997 WHEAT CROP-MP.

text.p: Romania's 1997 wheat harvest could be jeopardised unless the government takes speedy action to allocate more funds for purchases and storage, a senior member of parliament said on Tuesday.

"Any delays will have dramatic consequences not only for the farming sector but also for the whole economy," Trita Fanita, head of the Senate's commission for farming, food and forestry, said in a letter to Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
Fanita accused Ciorbea's centrist cabinet of failing to take steps to ensure the smooth purchase of the crop at appropriate prices.

"The conditions on the world market show no signs of improvement, the majority of farmers are unable to sell their crop and the burden of debts is becoming overwhelming," Fanita said, adding that slow harvesting added to the problem.
Ministry officials were unavailable for comment.

Last week, the Agriculture Ministry said it had agreed with wheat producers to propose a wheat subsidy of 150,000 lei per tonne in addition to the present purchasing price ranging from 750,000 to 800,000 lei.
Analysts say the purchasing price is too low to cover producers' costs.
"All this presages a big national crisis unless steps are taken immediately," said Fanita, who is also the general manager of the large Agroexport SA grain trading company.
The ministry has forecast a wheat harvest of 7.07 million tonnes, almost double the level last year, while exports are seen at over two million tonnes.
But some analysts say recent rains and lack of adequate financing to buy and store the crop might bring down these figures.
So far, the ministry has made no revision of its wheat crop estimate, despite adverse weather in recent days.
Media reports say rain and flooding have put 1,000 hectares under water and affected the quality of part of the crop.
A ministry official on Monday acknowledged that harvesting would be seriously delayed by the bad weather.
